description: We are enthusiastic students passionate about technology, innovation, and space exploration. Our project, ASTROCARE, aims to develop intelligent health monitoring software for astronauts, tracking vital signs and detecting potential health risks during space missions. We welcome passionate team members interested in Python, AI/ML, data analysis, UI/UX design, healthcare technology, and space science. Beginners and creative thinkers are welcome. Let's collaborate and make space missions safer!
